scene.title: One shape
scene.note: It is an outline with 3 straight sides.

script.title: Flat or solid? Name the whole shape

beats.say: Here is a square drawn on paper.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: Flat means no thickness: just across and up.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: This toy block has thickness too. Its shape is solid.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: We name the shape the picture shows.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: A face is a flat part on the outside.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: Champ, is the whole block flat or solid? What is its name?
beats.speaker: teacher

do.text: Look at the whole block. Is it flat or solid? What is its name?

beats.say: Square? I see a square here.
beats.speaker: learner

beats.say: That face is square. Look at the whole block.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: It has six square faces, all the same size. That solid is a cube.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: The square is one flat face. The whole block is a solid cube.
beats.speaker: learner

beats.say: Look at this round drawing. Is it flat or solid? What is its name?
beats.speaker: teacher

do.text: Look at the shape on the paper. Is it flat or solid? What is its name?

beats.say: It's coloured in. Does that make it solid?
beats.speaker: learner

beats.say: Colour fills the drawing. It adds no thickness.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: Compare a ball. It has thickness and is round every way.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: The ball's solid shape is called a sphere.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: The shape on the paper is flat and round. It's a circle.
beats.speaker: learner

beats.say: A door's outline makes this shape. Flat or solid? What is its name?
beats.speaker: teacher

do.text: Look at this shape. Is it flat or solid? What is its name?

beats.say: A side is a straight piece of the outline. Two are long; two are short.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: Square corners fit a paper corner. This shape has four.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: It's flat. The name is rectangle, even standing tall.
beats.speaker: learner

beats.say: This shape is tilted. Flat or solid? What is its name?
beats.speaker: teacher

do.text: Look at this shape. Is it flat or solid? What is its name?

beats.say: Its four sides have equal lengths, and its four corners are square.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: Flat, square. Turning it doesn't give it thickness.
beats.speaker: learner

beats.say: A party hat has this shape. Flat or solid? What is its name?
beats.speaker: teacher

do.text: Look at the party-hat shape. Is it flat or solid? What is its name?

beats.say: Triangle? It comes to a point.
beats.speaker: learner

beats.say: A triangle is flat, with three straight sides.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: The hat curves around a circular end and narrows to a point.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: That solid shape is a cone.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: Here is a shape like a soup can. Flat or solid? What is its name?
beats.speaker: teacher

do.text: Look at this shape. Is it flat or solid? What is its name?

beats.say: Solid. Two matching circle ends, with a curved surface between them.
beats.speaker: learner

beats.say: That solid is a cylinder.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: The dashed line shows the hidden part of its bottom edge.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: The ends are circles. The whole can shape is a cylinder.
beats.speaker: learner

beats.say: First, decide whether the picture shows a flat shape or a solid.
beats.speaker: teacher

beats.say: Then name the whole shape. A flat face can belong to a solid.
beats.speaker: teacher
